Triage: `pm:queue`, `domain:cli` (anchoring rule: `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin.applySideEffects` lives in `packages/cli` — verified on `origin/main`), type Bug, **`target:v17`** — release-board category ① (a published-surface defect a customer hits today: the designed marketplace distribution path leaves every post-install organization empty on walled deployments). Measured end-to-end on a real boot with a real artifact, with the installer-org control proving the probe live.

Dedup run: #3453 (closed) is the merge half this card explicitly builds on; no open card covers the replayer registration. Not folded into #9011 (same endpoint, different axis — that one is the anonymous-read disclosure decision, this one is a functional break).

Dispatch notes for the cli seat:
- Fix shape per the card: `applySideEffects` registers via the same `registerSeedReplayerOnce` helper `AppPlugin` uses (register-once semantics make the already-mounted-host case a no-op by construction). Test the no-host-data shape specifically — that is the shape the bug lives in.
- ⚠️ **Cross-repo pin flip, pre-register it in the dispatch**: `apps/objectos-ee/test/hotcrm-install-local.acceptance.ts` in `cloud` pins the *defect* (the `datasets present but no replayer registered` line) and goes RED when this lands. The claim comment's serial-constraints line must name it; the consuming-side follow-up card in `cloud` is the accepting seat's obligation at ACCEPT time (file it with `Blocked-by:` this card).
- Same-file check before dispatch: #9011's eventual ruling touches the same endpoint's routing — if #9011 is ruled and dispatched first, re-verify this card's surface on the merged ref (and vice versa).

Triage: this comment is from the triage seat (scheduled run) — no claim.

Serial constraints cleared: **`packages/cloud-connection` is free** — no other in-flight card in this lane touches it. ⚠️ Same-day churn on this exact file: `01074e5` (2026-08-17, #9256, the #9011 install-local auth narrowing) landed **today**; premise re-verified against it below. Sibling in flight #9120 / PR #9291 is `packages/rest` only — disjoint. ⚠️ **Cross-repo pin flip pre-registered:** `apps/objectos-ee/test/hotcrm-install-local.acceptance.ts` in `objectstack-ai/cloud` pins the *defect* (`datasets present but no replayer registered`) and is expected to go RED when this lands; the consuming-side follow-up card in `cloud` is this seat's obligation at ACCEPT time.

**Premise re-verified on `origin/main` @ `68cd4e7` by the PM before dispatch** (not inherited from the card): `applySideEffects` is at `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1212`; step 2 calls `mergeSeedDatasetsIntoKernel`, step 3 seeds inline, and **`registerSeedReplayerOnce` appears nowhere in `packages/cloud-connection`** — it is exported from `packages/runtime` (`seed-datasets.ts:98`, re-exported at `runtime/src/index.ts:70`) and used only by `app-plugin.ts:1029`.

⚠️ **One correction to the triage comment, carried so it is not re-derived wrongly:** triage states the fix "lives in `packages/cli` — verified on `origin/main`". **It does not.** `packages/cli` only names the class in comments and constructs it (`serve.ts:2092/2133`). The fix lands in `packages/cloud-connection`. The lane is unchanged (`cloud-connection` is cli-lane ground), but the package is not the one triage named — do not go looking in `packages/cli`.

⭐ The step-3 comment block already states *"don't rely on the `seed-replayer` registered by AppPlugin since (a) it isn't registered when the host runtime has no AppPlugin app with seed data"*. The author knew the replayer can be absent and handled only the **immediate** seed path; the **future-organization replay** path is the one still unserved. That is the defect, and it is worth reading before writing.

## ACCEPT — PR #9341

Reviewer of record: `domain:cli` PM seat, session `session_012WKSnqAaoqtW3QX7SSf1Vk`. Checked against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report's self-description.

**Checklist:** draft ✅ · base `main` ✅ · first line `Fixes #9070` ✅ · 3 changed files, all inside the declared surface ✅ · `packages/runtime` **not** edited and the `cloud` repo untouched, as instructed ✅ · changeset `@objectstack/cloud-connection: patch` ✅ · path fork clean ✅ · no `packages/spec/src/**`, so no contract-review hold ✅ · **all five required checks green, each read from its own job `conclusion`** — `TypeScript Type Check`, `ESLint`, `Test Core` (4/4), `Dogfood Regression Gate` (4/4), `Build Core` — ⛔ not from an aggregate ✅ · zero failing checks at `3d4eb45ce` ✅

### Spot readings

**The fix is placed where the defect was, not merely where it is visible.** Registration sits next to the merge in step 2, so the "merge landed, consumer never did" split cannot recur, and it covers the rehydrate path (`seedNow: false`) where a restarted runtime gets its replayer back. The guarded lazy-import mirrors the sibling `mergeSeedDatasetsIntoKernel` exactly, which is what the dispatch asked for rather than a new shape.

**The forbidden remedy was available and was not used.** `check-slot-lookup-ratchet.mjs --update` would have turned the red gate green in one command. Verified independently: `scripts/slot-lookup-baseline.json` is **absent from the diff**, and reads **16** on both the branch and `main`. The dev also reported the per-file number (`MEASURED: 16 | BASELINE: 16`) rather than a bare green, which is what was asked. Note the ratchet errors in *both* directions, so 16 is the only passing value — that is a stronger guarantee than "not worse".

**`errorList` is a measured consequence, not a decoration.** The per-org replayer's consumer reports `summary?.errors?.length` and samples `.slice(0, 5)`; handing it a count makes a failed replay read as "0 error(s)" through the optional chaining. Adding the raw array beside the count is the correct shape, and it is the one change in this PR that is not literally "register a replayer" — correctly flagged as such.

**Inline fallback vs the real helper.** The dev describes the fallback as mirroring `registerSeedReplayerOnce` "byte for byte in behaviour". Close, with one divergence worth recording rather than changing: the runtime helper's guard short-circuits on `getService` returning `undefined` and never consults `kernel.getService`, while the fallback falls through and checks both. The fallback is therefore *safer* — it cannot displace an incumbent replayer where the helper could attempt a register and swallow the throw. Both return `false` in that case, so no observable outcome differs. Accepted as an improvement; the phrase overstates it slightly.

**Reverse verification held.** Direction predicted before running (8 red / 1 green), observed exactly. The single green case is the "never displaces a host's existing replayer" control, green against unfixed code *by construction* — correctly reported as a control rather than counted as a defect pin.

### Deviations

- **Round-1 process incident, independently verified as fully repaired.** The dev's first changeset used an auto-generated filename that collided with an existing one on `main` and overwrote a `service-analytics` changeset. It self-caught this (`git add` showed `M`, not `A`), restored, and reported it. Checked rather than accepted: that file is **byte-identical** between branch and `main` and is **absent** from this PR's 3-file diff. Nothing broken reached the remote.
- **One patch round** for the `check:slot-lookup` breach — two new service lookups used the split-declaration erasure shape. Fixed by typing both against their declared contracts (`IObjectQLEngine`, `IMetadataService`), keeping the `| undefined` declarations and try/catch. The real contract types surfaced no error the `any` had been hiding — checked specifically.
- **Infrastructure noise, not this PR.** `Check PR Size` and `Auto Label` failed twice on a `codeload.github.com` 429 that prevented their third-party actions from downloading at all — both died before running any body. Neither is in the ruleset's required set. A spaced re-run cleared them on attempt 3; the PR now has zero failing checks.

⭐ **Carrying forward the dev's own diagnosis, because it generalises.** Round 1 reported the gate union as "all exit 0" while `check:slot-lookup` was red on that commit. The cause was not a skipped step: `dispatch-gates.mjs` derives gates from changed **paths** and a fixed set of change **kinds**, and `slot-lookup` triggers on "a source file that performs service lookups" — a convention it does not model. ⇒ **Derive the gate list from the CI job, not from the path derivation.** `dispatch-gates.mjs` names which jobs are in play; it is never the union itself. Two devs hit this same blind spot this round.

### Consuming-side follow-up filed

**objectstack-ai/cloud#1419** (`pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by:` this card) — `apps/objectos-ee/test/hotcrm-install-local.acceptance.ts` pins the defect and inverts when this lands; the test's own failure message already prescribes promoting it rather than deleting it. ⚠️ It becomes actionable only when that repo's `.objectstack-sha` is bumped past this fix, not when this merges: the pin is a genuine ancestor **177 commits** behind `main` (REST `compare`; a shallow-clone `merge-base` reports a false non-ancestor there).

⇒ Flipping ready and enqueuing.
